name: deck-exec-two-pager
description: Writes a two-slide executive summary in Claude Slides with the key points and the ask on slide one and, on slide two, only the insights your sources actually show, or a plain note that there are none. Use for "run deck-exec-two-pager", "two-slide exec summary", "one slide is not enough", "add the insights slide", "what surprised us slide", "exec summary with the trend behind the number", part of the Claude Slides for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
